apps.localizedDescription:
Palladium:

On-device iOS media downloader powered by yt-dlp, gallery-dl, ffmpeg, and PythonKit.

App Screenshots:

This URL is not allowed by the configured download allowlists.

To allow downloads from any URL, visit getpalladium.app/allowlist and click Add to Palladium.

(Allowlists not required after v1.3.2+).

What It Does:

• Uses yt-dlp for media extraction, gallery-dl for images, and ffmpeg for processing.
• Runs Python tooling inside the app.

While it is actively tested and continuously improved, you may still encounter bugs. Feedback is greatly appreciated. If you find a bug, please open an issue and we’ll work to fix it.

Download:

• .ipa from GitHub.

• Nightly: GitHub Actions.
